## Checklist

- [ ] `cd web && python manage.py test` passes
- [ ] `python -m pytest engine/tests -q` passes
- [ ] `ruff check . && ruff format --check .` passes
- [ ] New interface text has a Persian translation
- [ ] `docs/engine_api.md` / `engine.example.yaml` updated if the API or a setting changed
- [ ] No secrets, paths from my machine, model files or videos are included
